parts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate SIX distinct consecutive turntable viewpoints of the exact SAME garment in the reference. Reference is the design identity sheet, LEFT front, RIGHT back. Pocket Pilot Bomber, charcoal grey-green nylon canvas #363d3c, beige ribbed bomber collar/cuffs/waistband #cfbc98, full central metal zipper, TWO lower cargo flap pockets each with TWO beige straps and buckles, utility zip flap pockets on upper sleeves, relaxed long sleeves. Beige small ML left chest, beige MiloShopHand script upper back. Retain all pocket/strap/zipper locations and correct rib trim EXACTLY as reference. Create exactly THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, 6 equal-sized cells, native 1536x1024 or larger (512px per cell). Frames0-5 in row-major order: 0 EXACT FRONT,15,30,45,60,75degrees. Slowly turn from the front towards the wearer's left side. Chest logo progressively foreshortens, back script is not visible. Rotate the physical garment about the UPRIGHT VERTICAL Y axis only. Camera fixed and level; no pitch, roll, leaning or flat-picture tilting. Same entire garment centered and fully visible in every cell, same scale, soft cloth folds, sleeve pose and lighting. Thin sides must really appear narrow. Logo perspective must be natural, never mirror text. Uniform pale warm ivory studio background, soft even editorial light. Empty garment, no body, mannequin, hanger, stand, labels, angle numbers, borders, gutters, grid lines or watermark. Keep 5% margin in each cell. Match the reference's fabric, colour, cut, seams, drape, all pockets and closures. Do not simplify or redesign the garment.
